weapons.name: Kavalos Steed's Hooves, Teeth, and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The targets have Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Still Their Breath!
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers Cavalry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If this unit is in combat, no relentless discipline points are spent. The target's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Arkhan the Black, Mortarch of Sacrament

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Razarak's Ebon Claws is 3.

abilities.name: The Staff of Spirits
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, Heal (1) this unit after that Spell ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: The Doom of Traitors
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a Wizard or Priest. On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Razarak's Ebon Claws for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit. Designer's Note: *If the target is a* Wizard *or* Priest*, this ability cannot fail; however you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.*

abilities.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that Spell ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Curse of Years
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 6: • Give the target 1 necrotic withering point. • Roll an extra dice. For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points. Then, do the same for each 4+, and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 necrotic withering point (do not roll any extra dice), After a roll, if the target has 8 or more necrotic withering points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of necrotic withering points it has. Then, those necrotic withering points are lost.

abilities.name: Bone Harvest
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a Fight ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is full.

abilities.name: Bone Cage
abilities.effect: This unit is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.

abilities.name: Repair Construct
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1, return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

abilities.name: Immortal Bulwark
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Nadirite Bow
abilities.declare: If this unit's Nohem is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Mir Kainan
abilities.effect: While this unit's Mir Kainan is on the battlefield, this unit has Wizard (1), Relentless Discipline (2) and can be picked as the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability as if it had the Hero keyword.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its Relentless Discipline keyword is 4.

abilities.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units that have used any Relentless Discipline abilities this turn.

abilities.name: Aviarch Spymaster
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: You Dare?!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half the units from your starting army have been destroyed.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round: • Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Inda-Khaat. • Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's The Shield Immortis. • This unit cannot use the 'Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions' ability.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend a number of relentless discipline points equal to the target's Health characteristic. The target can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use Relentless Discipline abilities for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Deathrider Wedge
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly Liege-Kavalos within this unit's combat range to be the friendly target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the enemy target if you picked a friendly target. Then, this unit and the friendly target (if any) can move 10". They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed's Hooves, Teeth, and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Scything Assault
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

abilities.name: Pinning Attacks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. • Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. • The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed's Hooves, Teeth, and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Deathrider Commander
abilities.effect: This unit and visible friendly Kavalos Deathriders units wholly within 12" Of this unit can move 12" instead of 10" when they use the 'Deathrider Wedge' ability.

abilities.name: Master of Cavalry
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Kavalos Deathriders unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed's Hooves, Teeth, and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Grind Them to Dust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly Kavalos War Chariots wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Masterful Charioteer
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat and has charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly Kavalos War Chariots that have charged this turn, that are wholly within 12" Of this unit and that are in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Clinical Efficiency
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase, Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly Mortek Guard, Mortek Triaxes or Mortek Crawler unit that has not used an Attack ability this phase and is wholly within 12" Of this unit to be the target. Immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use either a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase or a Fight ability. If it is picked to do so: • Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn. • The target's ranged weapons (if any) have Shoot in Combat for the rest of the turn. • If the target uses a Shoot ability and is not in combat, all of its shooting attacks must target units in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Discharge Armour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (3+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Harbingers of Death
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Deathly Barrage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit.
abilities.effect: After that Shoot ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Mortisan Ossifector, and add 1 to the roll if any other friendly Mortek Crawler units picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 4+, the target has Strike-Last for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Cursed Stele
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • This unit's ranged weapons have Anti-Faction Terrain (+1 Rend). • Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's ranged weapons for attacks that target faction terrain features.

abilities.name: Shields of the Legion
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability that targeted a visible Ossiarch Bonereapers unit within this unit's combat range.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Shields of the Legion
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: A friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers War Machine or Wizardwithin this unit's combat range was targeted by an Attack ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Balefire Braziers
abilities.effect: This unit's Balefire Braziers are tokens. There are 2 Balefire Braziers for every 10 models in this unit. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its Balefire Braziers next to it.

abilities.name: Cursed Flames
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit.
abilities.effect: After that Shoot ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and this unit has any Balefire Braziers next to it, place 1 of those Balefire Braziers next to that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Atavistic Nightmares
abilities.effect: While any of this unit's Balefire Braziers are next to an enemy unit, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units within that enemy unit's combat range. If an ability would heal or return slain models to an enemy unit while any of this unit's Balefire Braziers are next to it, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, place those Balefire Braziers next to this unit.

abilities.name: Necrocaches
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: No Escaping the Tithe
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If there are no enemy units within 6" of this unit, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Coldness of Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If an enemy Hero was destroyed by this unit's combat attacks this turn, your opponent must reduce their fury level to 0.

abilities.name: Terminate their Command
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible enemy Hero within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

abilities.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Boneshaper
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mortek Guard or Mortek Triaxes unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat.

abilities.name: Boneshaper
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mortek Guardunit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Refined Creations
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai or Morghast Harbingers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Soul-guide
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Soulreaper
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Necrotic Impetus
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.

units.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Death unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Death unit, pick 1 of the following effects: • Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3. • The target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Fourfold Slayers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If this unit has 3 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

abilities.name: Bone-deep Savagery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can move 3". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Hunters Unleashed
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Truebone Mastery
abilities.effect: Spend any number of this unit's portions of truebone. For each portion spent, pick 1 of the effects below. Each effect can be picked multiple times and the effects are cumulative. • Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. • Add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. • Gain 1 relentless discipline point. • Return 1 slain model to this unit.

abilities.name: Seeker of Truebone
abilities.effect: This unit can be picked to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability as if it had the Hero keyword. Each time a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit is destroyed, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit gains 1 portion of truebone. Each time a visible friendly non-Beast Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit is destroyed, this unit gains 1 portion of truebone.

abilities.name: Voice of Nagash
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-Core abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Mortal Contract
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a Core ability, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that Core ability.

units.name: Vokmortian, Master of the Bone-tithe (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Master of the Bone-Tithe
abilities.effect: Your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects: Pay the Tithe: Your opponent must pick a unit in their army on the battlefield to be the target. They cannot pick a Manifestation or terrain feature. Then: • Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. • Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be healed, have slain models returned to it or be replaced. Deny the Ossiarchs their Rightful Due: Pick 1 of the following effects: • You gain 4 relentless discipline points. • Pick an objective you do not control. For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units while they are contesting that objective. • For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic and add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Gaze of Death.

abilities.name: Cowed into Inaction
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an enemy unit within the target's combat range uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 rage dice to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are lost.

battleTraits.name: Immortal Elite
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any Ossiarch Bonereapers Heroes on the battlefield. Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Hero to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number after the target's Relentless Discipline keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battleTraits.name: Impassive Retreat
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Ruthless Extermination
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for a unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that Shoot ability.

battleTraits.name: Pitiless Assault
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that Fight ability.

battleTraits.name: Remorseless March
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit that has not used a Relentless Discipline ability this phase to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use run abilities for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Inviolate Legions
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability.
battleTraits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. That unit has Ward (5+) against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that Attack ability.

abilities.name: Grim Sentinels
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

abilities.name: Remorseless Conquerors
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Run ability for a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit.
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Nadirite Wedge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Silent Empire
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

abilities.name: Immaculate Defender
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Infantry unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Imperious Will
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a non-Hero Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-Hero unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Fight ability.

abilities.name: Manufactured Mind
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect: When picking a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Hero to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Hero that has been destroyed.

abilities.name: Amulet of Gnosis
abilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units by Retreat abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Blade of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Shard of the Necris
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Drain Vitality
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) until the start of your next turn. If all of the target's non-Companion melee weapons had Crit (2 Hits) when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead. Friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers units can be affected by this ability multiple times.

abilities.name: Immolating Flames
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Bone‑tithe Shrieker on the battlefield, pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Bone-tithe Shrieker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulstealer Carrion on the battlefield, pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulstealer Carrion wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: No Escape
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Death Incarnate
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation was destroyed or banished this turn and the unit that summoned it is on the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 4+, set up this Manifestation again, wholly within 12" of the unit that summoned it and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit has summoned that Manifestation. Add 1 to the roll if any enemy models were slain by this Manifestation's combat attacks this turn.

abilities.name: Aviarch Sentry
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
